name: MonarchStatusBadge
title: StatusBadge
wrapsNative: Text and Image in a Capsule (as MonarchBadge), or MonarchStatusDot for the dot variant
summary: A status shown as words, a tone and a distinct icon or dot, looked up by key in a registry of built-in and app-defined statuses.
whenToUse: Wherever the same set of statuses appears many times (services, tickets, deployments) and should look the same everywhere.
whenNotToUse: For a one-off label, use MonarchBadge. For a live state such as "Running" with a pulse, use MonarchStatusDot. For something people act on, use MonarchTag.
api: init(_ status: String?, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, label: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, showsIcon: Bool = true, variant: MonarchStatusBadgeVariant = .subtle, size: MonarchStatusBadgeSize = .md)
init(_ definition: MonarchStatusDefinition, showsIcon: Bool = true, variant: MonarchStatusBadgeVariant = .subtle, size: MonarchStatusBadgeSize = .md)
MonarchStatusDefinition.init(_ label: String, tone: MonarchTone, systemImage: String? = nil, description: String? = nil)
MonarchStatusRegistry.init<Key: RawRepresentable>(_ definitions: [Key: MonarchStatusDefinition]) where Key.RawValue == String
func monarchStatusRegistry(_ registry: MonarchStatusRegistry) -> some View
enum MonarchStatusBadgeVariant { case subtle, outline, solid, dot }

options.name: status
options.description: The key: built-in (operational, degraded, partial, down, maintenance, unknown, success, warning, danger, info, neutral) or from a registry. nil is unknown.

options.name: registry
options.description: Statuses for this badge only, looked up before the installed registries and the built-in set.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: Replaces the registry's SF Symbol; in the dot variant it replaces the dot.

options.name: showsIcon
options.description: Hides the icon when false; the label still carries the meaning.

options.name: size
options.description: sm uses caption text, md label text.

options.name: definition
options.description: Second initialiser: the label, tone and symbol given directly.

states.name: known
states.description: The registry's label, tone and symbol.

states.name: unknown
states.description: The neutral tone, a question mark symbol and a label made from the key ("pending_delete" reads "Pending delete"); nil reads "Unknown".

appearance: Subtle is a tinted capsule with strong-coloured text, outline a capsule with the tone's border, solid a filled capsule, all from the tone roles of the theme. The dot variant is a MonarchStatusDot: a dot in the tone's solid colour and default-coloured text.
platformNotes: The web registry also accepts a custom #rrggbb colour per status, passed through a contrast guard. iOS takes colours only from the theme by role, so a status picks one of the five tones; workspace-defined colours are not offered. The web has no accent tone equivalent here because MonarchTone has no accent case. The web's StatusRegistryProvider is the monarchStatusRegistry(_:) modifier; defineStatuses is a MonarchStatusRegistry built from a dictionary, typed by an enumeration with string raw values. Android shares the name and the built-in set.
accessibility: One element read as the label.
The icon and the dot are decorative; every built-in health status has a symbol of a different shape, and the label always names the status.
An unknown key is read as words made from the key, never as a raw identifier.
edgeCases: A long label wraps inside the capsule; keep labels to a few words.
Nested monarchStatusRegistry(_:) calls add up; the innermost wins where two define the same key.
The description of a definition is not drawn; use it for a legend.
